action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # --- input validation ---
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
                      (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
                      (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a two-dimensional matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} is empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0.0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # shapes must match
    s = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != s or logp_no_call.shape != s:
        raise ValueError("shape mismatch among input matrices")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    # --- numerical procedure ---
    with_sum = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
    call_sum = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
    no_sum = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)

    alternative_max = np.maximum(call_sum, no_sum)
    margins = with_sum - alternative_max
    keep = margins > tau_filter

    return keep, margins
